environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith directly via gunicorn on port 8080, exposed through a classic ELB with no additional filtering. Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF or CloudFront distribution in front. The OAuth provider (auth.internal.corp) does not enforce strict redirect_uri matching on its side - it accepts any redirect_uri that was passed in the authorization request as long as the client_id is valid.
